title: ORP Drop After Heavy Feeding
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:feeding
| stats avg(orp_delta_30m) as avg_orp_delta_30m min(orp_delta_30m) as worst_orp_delta_30m by tank food_type
| sort worst_orp_delta_30m
description: Shows how much oxidation-reduction potential falls after different feeding events.
value: Feeding is one of the clearest routine stressors in a reef system, and ORP response helps quantify how disruptive it is.
implementation: Log feedings with food type and the 30-minute ORP delta derived from the tank controller.
visualization: Table of average and worst ORP drop by tank and food type.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how sharply water quality signals dip after different kinds of feedings.
